we have designed a speech processor with the following characteristics: (1) it is a general purpose speech processor that is programmable and can be used in many different applications (2) the processor has a low power consumption of less than 10mW and can be implemented in a 65nm CMOS process and (3) the processor can perform ASR and VAD in real time.

The main takeaway from our work is that
NN based ASR and VAD can be efficiently implemented in hardware.
deep NNs can be implemented with digital circuits that achieve high performance, low power, and low area, while also being programmable, scalable, and robust to variations in the NN structure.
the NN-based ASR architecture has low enough power consumption that it is competitive with traditional architectures, and that NNs can be efficiently implemented in digital circuits.
